data.description:
## Description

**What**: Run scan-todo-comments.sh against plugins/dso/ (excluding test files) and process each finding per its disposition_hint.

**Why**: SC-1 and SC-5 require every comment evaluated and either removed, fixed, or ticketed with original text and location preserved.

**Scope**: For each finding: (a) auto-remove-candidate → delete the comment, (b) quick-fix-candidate single-task scope → apply fix inline and remove comment (RED test if behavior changes), (c) ticket-candidate → create ticket with original text + file:line, replace comment with KIND(ticket-id): reference, (d) already-ticketed → verify ticket open; if closed remove stale comment. Write disposition log to docs/findings/epic-5018-64ce-todo-sweep.md.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Every TODO/FIXME/HACK/WORKAROUND in non-test plugin files is removed, fixed-and-removed, or replaced with KIND(ticket-id): reference
- Re-running scan-todo-comments.sh produces zero findings with ticket-candidate or auto-remove-candidate disposition
- docs/findings/epic-5018-64ce-todo-sweep.md records one row per finding (path, line, kind, original_text, disposition, resulting_ticket_or_commit)
- Created tickets have original comment text and original path:line in description
- Pre-existing test suite still passes
data.title: UPDATE: Disposition production TODO/FIXME/HACK/WORKAROUND comments (sweep execution)
